title: Dossier consolidation and area tags
summary: Plan for the operator's decision on AGT-W53 (2026-09-13): the current Dossier list shrinks from 37 to 16 (four new theme Dossiers for delivery chain, observation, gates and task UI; the North star rewritten to the September topology; eleven kept), partially superseded Dossiers are merged into their theme Dossier and recorded as superseded, implemented ones are archived only when their durable knowledge has a documentation home (artefact table per Dossier). Second part: the review's categories become a general tag system with areas that own a glossary (ubiquitous language), area and facet tags on cards and Dossiers, an auto-tagging pipeline step that runs by default in every project on card and Dossier creation with a cheap classification model route, a backfill for the 862 untagged cards and 54 Dossiers, and maintenance proposals as decision cards. Six operator decisions D1-D6, nine implementation cards.

implementationTasks.title: Consolidate: rewrite the North star (AGT-W14) to the September topology and absorb W6, W8, W22, W25 as history
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Consolidate: North star rewrite

Mode: concept. Source of truth: docs/operations/dossier-consolidation-and-area-tags (AGT-W55) with the operator's answers to D1 and D2, and the AGT-W53 matrix.

Rewrite docs/operations/nordstern (AGT-W14) so that it is again the single entry point to the target picture at today's state: Operations Server beside the Task Server (AGT-W49) and isolated execution with preparation scripts (AGT-W51) are the live decisions and are linked, not copied. Absorb the superseded Dossiers W6 (container default), W8 (installer story), W22 (implementation plan), W25 (components and protocols) as short history sections that name the decision that replaced each. Keep the four concept sections and the house style (template docs/operations/docker-ausfuehrungswelt-migration). Then record W6, W8, W22, W25 as superseded by AGT-W14 in their descriptors (review block: verdict, supersededBy, reviewedAt, reviewedBy, note) and set their status so they leave the current list. English. Report what was dropped and why.

implementationTasks.title: Tag system backend: areas with glossaries, area and facet tags on cards and Dossiers, product defaults with project additions, API
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Tag system backend

Context: AGT-W55 §5 with the operator's answers to D3; existing pieces: workspace tag registry (TagRegistryEntry, tags.json, GET /api/tags), card tags (TaskInfo.Tags, PUT /api/tasks/{id}/tags), Dossier descriptor field pattern.

Deliver: (1) an areas registry per project with product defaults (the areas decided in D3) and project additions declared in the project definition; each area has id, label, description and a glossary (term, definition, synonyms) stored as a wiki page under the area; (2) tags typed as area or facet in the registry; (3) Dossier tags in the descriptor schema (workbench.json tags[]) and in the catalogue projection, article front matter for wiki pages; (4) API: GET/PUT areas and glossary, tags on Dossiers, filter parameters (area, tag) on the task list, Dossier list and wiki tree endpoints; (5) validation: unknown tag ids are refused, area ids are stable; (6) tests. No auto-tagging here (separate card).

implementationTasks.title: Auto-tagging step: pipeline default for card and Dossier creation in every project, classification model route, backfill with report
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Auto-tagging step

Context: AGT-W55 §5 with the operator's answers to D4 and D5; depends on the tag system backend card.

Deliver: (1) a pipeline step 'auto-tag' that runs by default on card creation and on Dossier creation in every project (opt-out in the project definition): input title and body, the registry as a closed list, the area glossaries as context; output area tags and facet tags with confidence; below a threshold it stores proposals instead of tags and marks the item 'tags proposed'; (2) a classification route in model routing (cheapest available model, low thinking, bounded prompt, token cap) so tagging never uses the coding class; record cost per call in the token ledger; (3) a backfill job for existing cards and Dossiers of a project with a dry-run report (counts per area, low-confidence list) and an apply mode; (4) activity feed lines and a visible marker on tagged items; (5) tests with a fixture registry and golden examples; (6) docs: the step in the pipeline docs and the project-definition option.

implementationTasks.title: Tag maintenance: periodic proposals to retire, merge and add tags and to update area glossaries, delivered as decision cards
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Tag maintenance

Context: AGT-W55 §5 with the operator's answer to D6; depends on the tag system backend; uses decision cards (AGT-W54) once they exist, prose cards until then.

Deliver: a periodic step per project that reviews tag usage and proposes changes: retire unused tags, merge near-duplicates, add tags for frequently co-occurring free terms, add glossary terms from new Dossier decisions and ADRs; each proposal is a decision card with options and consequences; applying a decision updates registry and glossary and rewrites affected tags with an audit entry; nothing changes silently; report per run; tests.
